title: Watchdog console flash fix: windowless wscript wrapper for the scheduled task
notes: USER REPORT: a cmd window flashed open/closed at random intervals for days (worst while gaming); user suspected a virus. ROOT CAUSE: AtelierWatchdog fires every 5 min and invoked powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden directly - that flag hides the console only AFTER conhost allocates it, so every firing flashed a window in the interactive session, even when the studio marker was off and the script exited instantly. FIX: scripts/watchdog-quiet.vbs (wscript.exe has no console; Run(...,0,False) is truly invisible; resolves start-day.ps1 relative to itself) + task action repointed via Set-ScheduledTask. Verified: test fire returned 0x0, action XML shows wscript. ALSO in this session: diagnosed post-power-cut behavior for the user - marker survived the outage so the watchdog legitimately resurrected the stack at boot (first real crash-recovery test, passed); the 'two bots' were the venv launcher shim + real interpreter (one bot); run 20260804-baceee parked at visuals checkpoint (no auto-resume by design, use /resume). title: Studio must never auto-start after a reboot: boot-session-scoped marker
notes: USER DEMAND (emphatic): the studio turning itself on after every reboot/power cut was unwanted - it must only ever start via a single manual command. ROOT CAUSE: state/.studio-on persisted across reboots, so the watchdog legitimately resurrected the whole stack at every boot (designed as crash recovery, experienced as annoyance). FIX: start-day.ps1 stamps the marker with the current boot id (Win32_OperatingSystem.LastBootUpTime); the -IfOn watchdog path compares boot ids and on mismatch DELETES the marker and exits - after any restart the studio stays off until ./start-day.ps1 is run manually. Within-session self-healing (crashed llama/bot while the studio IS on) unchanged. VERIFIED live: stale-boot-id marker -> watchdog run deleted it, started nothing, exit 0. Also: .studio-on was accidentally git-TRACKED - now untracked + gitignored along with .render-lock and tts-oov.log. RUNBOOK watchdog section rewritten. title: Gemma spontaneous thinking-mode fix: --reasoning off on the gateway
notes: First Gemma production run (20260808-349445) died at the draft node: 'empty completion; finish_reason=length' after 3 retries. ROOT CAUSE (reproduced with the run's own evidence pack): Gemma 4 E4B spontaneously enters thinking mode on complex prompts (the research said opt-in; the model opts ITSELF in when the prompt is rich enough - the bench's simpler prompts never triggered it). llama-server routes the thoughts to reasoning_content; with long thinking the 1600-token budget exhausts before any content is emitted -> empty completion. FIX: '--reasoning off' on every llama-server launch (visuals.start_llama + start-day.ps1; b10092 supports it, default auto). Harmless for non-thinking brains (Qwen-2507). VERIFIED: repro call now returns reasoning_len=0, finish=stop, valid JSON, 2/2. Bot restarted so its cached start_llama carries the flag (the render choreography restarts llama mid-run - without the restart the flag would silently vanish after the first GPU dance). Run resumable from the draft checkpoint.

title: Gemma verbosity fix: adaptive max_tokens retry in the gateway + bigger draft budget

TWO FIXES: (1) gateway chat_json retry is now failure-aware - finish_reason=length grows max_tokens 60% per attempt (cap 4800) instead of pointlessly raising temperature; other failures keep the temp bump.
